metadata.name: GetTransactionHistory
metadata.description: Use this API to fetch monetary transaction posted on a card account. Combination of multiple filters such as date range, Transaction ID, Minimum Transaction Amount, Maximum Transaction Amount and Transaction type are present to fetch records of all transactions, settled transactions, outstanding transactions, expired transactions.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of records to be returned in a page Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100,50  will return 100 or 50 transactions at once.

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Page Number Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 0,1,2

request_fields.name: TransactionId
request_fields.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example : 147852369 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: To set transactions boundary 'From Date' Format : YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Valid Values:0-9 Example : 2015-12-11 00:00:00 Condition:Required only when ToDate is passed in Input

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: To set transactions boundary 'To Date' Format : YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Valid Values:0-9 Example : 2015-12-11 00:00:00 Condition:Required only when FromDate is passed in Input.

request_fields.name: MinimumTransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transactions can be searched by Transaction amount greater or equal to Minimum Transaction Amount. Format: XXX.XX Example: 25.00

request_fields.name: MaximumTransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Transactions can be searched by Transaction amount less than or equal to Maximum Transaction Amount. Format: XXX.XX Example: 25.00

request_fields.name: TransactionHistoryType
request_fields.description: Type of Transaction’s History. Valid Values: 0 or Null = All Transactions 1 = Settled Transactions 2 = Outstanding Transactions 3 = Expired Transactions 5 = Post Credit Transaction 6 = Saving Transaction Example: 1 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: WalletID
request_fields.description: Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: AvailableBalance
children.description: Available balance on the account. Valid values : 0-9 Example: 100.50 Note: In case of the non wallet product, tag will return the account available balance whereas in case of the multi wallet product, tag will return wallet available balance.

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: This tag indicates the current balance of the account. Condition: In case of the non wallet product, tag will return the account current balance whereas in case of the multi wallet product, tag will return wallet current balance.

children.name: LastTransactionDate
children.description: Date of Last transaction posted on account Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: LastCreditDate
children.description: Last Credit Date of Account/Card. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T13:05:10

children.name: LastCreditAmount
children.description: Last Credited Amount in the card Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 150.00

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: Disputed amount on the card Example : 100

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting description of transaction Example:Transaction posted successfully

children.name: TransactionSource
children.description: Transaction Source field is used to identify the source of transaction in CoreCard System. Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 'Transaction Source Type'

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: Description of transaction Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Load

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: This tag indicates the current balance of the account

children.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
children.description: Name and location details of merchant Valid Values: a-z A-Z Example: Dental merchant, Nashua

children.name: TransactionReason
children.description: Memo reason against transaction Example:Disputed, Dispute Denied, etc.

children.name: OverLimitFlag
children.description: Indicates whether the transaction has overcome the single transaction limit of a particular transaction type or not. Valid Values: Y or N

children.name: DeclineIndicator
children.description: Indicator for Declined Transaction Valid Values: Yes , No Example: Yes

children.name: MerchantCity
children.description: Merchant City Valid Values: a-z, A-Z Example:Atlanta

children.name: Comment
children.description: Additional Comment can be specified for a transaction. Valid values :A-Z, a-z

children.name: TransactionType
children.description: Transaction Code which indicates type of transaction

children.name: CardNumber4Digits
children.description: Last  4 digits of the card. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 4386

children.name: ProductBin
children.description: It shows bin value of card i.e. first six digits of the card. Example: 406684

children.name: CardNumber
children.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001

children.name: CustomAccountID
children.description: Any custom ID which is used to uniquely identify the Account. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:123456789 Condition:Mandatory If Custom Account ID on product as Enabled.

children.name: WalletID
children.description: This tag indicates Wallet ID of wallet mapped on account. Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: WalletName
children.description: This tag indicates the name of wallet. Example: HCA

children.name: ThreeDS
children.description: Indicate the status of the 3D Secure function. Valid values : - Authenticated - Attempted - Non-Secure - Product not enrolled

children.name: DisputedTransaction
children.description: Shows whether the transaction is Disputed or not. Example: Yes and No

children.name: DisputeCaseID
children.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example:9856198

children.name: DisputeRequestStatus
children.description: Shows the current dispute status. Example:Chargeback Initiated

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: Disputed amount on the card Example:600.30

children.name: TransactionLifeCycleUniqueID
children.description: Returns Unique LifeCycle ID of transaction

children.name: AvailableBalance
children.description: Available balance on the account Valid values : 0-9 Example: 100.50

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: TransactionId
children.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Example :  147852369

children.name: TransactionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time of Transaction. Format:YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example:2015-12-11T13:05:10

children.name: PostTime
children.description: Time of Transaction Posted/requested. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss Example: 2015-12-11T13:05:10

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11
